message: No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in this code slice; data appears to be loaded from local files without any checksum or integrity verification.
No detected label flipping detection: No code compares label distributions, validates labels against an expected set, or uses a label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The pipeline performs type casting, balancing, and LBP feature extraction but contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.
No detected model integrity verification: The code uses pickle for serialization and loads models without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity.

No detected label distribution validation: There is a BALANCE parameter that can undersample to equalize class proportions, but no explicit validation or check of label distribution or expected label sets before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics beyond accuracy, confusion matrix, and F1; no protections against metric manipulation are implemented.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path only reformats column names and casts dtypes for model compatibility; there are no shape checks, range validations, or schema enforcement on incoming inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validations are applied to model outputs before they are returned or used.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses image-based LightGBM/Naive Bayes classifiers, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
